svg.title: Any Cell, Any Time
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: an open shelf divided into three rows of three cubbies, with a square, a triangle, and a diamond above its columns and a thread circle beside each row. Most cubbies hold a box; one, at the left of the middle row, is empty. A mannequin slides a single hatched box into it. The shelf is the site's table: its columns are guides, governance, and theory (the square, triangle, and diamond) and its rows are threads. The boxes already in place are pieces other people have contributed. The hatched box is one contribution, the focus: a single guide, governance piece, essay, or pattern. Sliding it into one cubby while others in the same row are still missing is the solution: accept a contribution to any single cell at any time, without waiting for the rest of the row. The metaphor: a shared shelf that anyone can fill one cubby at a time.
